name: mono
description: Mono runtime (Unity fork, LLVM tiered JIT) -- the libraries the native build does not carry itself
$comment: Only what the tree has no copy of. mono/zlib, mono/eglib and msvc/getopt.c
cover the rest, and a vcpkg port that duplicates one of those would put two
implementations of the same symbol in the same link.

dependencies.name: zlib
dependencies.$comment: The runtime prefers a system zlib over the bundled mono/zlib; on Windows vcpkg is that system.

dependencies.name: gtest
dependencies.$comment: The C++ unit tests under mono/unit-tests. -DBUILD_TESTING=OFF drops the dependency.
